name: Science Skaters
description:
A fearful entity has taken over the world, but luckily the key to fight back is hidden inside your best friend’s body! A team of young, adventurous and brilliant scientists will shrink their bodies and use their skating skills to get inside their friend’s body and explore a world like they have never seen before!

Join Max, Jin, Lia and Zev in this fun adventure and skate around thanks to their customizable nano-skates, solve science puzzles adapted to different ages. Explore, learn and fight to save the future of humanity!

SKATE YOUR WAY THROUGH NEW WORLDS!

  • 25 different levels to explore, full of action and adventure!

  • +60 challenges to overcome: lasers, puzzles, typhoons, sticky walls, broken bridges, falling rocks…

  • Defeat or flee from lots of different types of enemies inside each level!

  • A vibrant, fun and colorful world inspired by the inside of the human body.

  • Will you be able to find the ultimate nanobot formula to save the world?

LEVEL UP YOUR SKILLS AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER!

  • 4 scientists to choose and play with

  • 20+ items to customize your character

  • Upgrade your nano-tools and get even stronger!

  • 7 nano-skills to unlock

LEARN, COLLECT AND KEEP THE FUN ROLLING!

  • Puzzles adapted to age

  • Fun facts about science to find and learn

  • Learn about the human body while saving the world!
